rationale: Mechanical validation confirms clean application, allowed files and preserved question schema. The patch adds a focused enforcement requirement to existing qualification rules, covering changed components, worker mismatches, stale approvals and dispatch/release races. It requires observable controller behavior and measurement of enforcement costs, while correctly retaining Open status. Its contribution is qualification enforcement rather than the outstanding measured hardware answer.
risks: The enforcement requirements remain unimplemented and unmeasured; this proposal establishes no minimum hardware profile or supported deployment.
Required bindings that cannot be verified for delegated services will withhold dependent modes; deployment evidence must demonstrate useful manual completion.
